question:
P, Q, R, S and T live on five different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1 , the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5 .

P lives immediately below T and immediately above S. P lives on an odd numbered floor. If R is not on the lowermost floor, where does T live?
solution:
Given: P, Q, R, S and T live on five different floors of the same building.

The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1 , the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 5 .

1) P lives on an odd numbered floor.

2) P lives immediately below T and immediately above S.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
